blocks.en_text: Has anyone ever told you, "Stand up straight!"
blocks.zh_text: 有没有人曾对你说过：“站直了！”

blocks.en_text: or scolded you for slouching at a family dinner?
blocks.zh_text: 或者因为你在家庭聚餐时弯腰驼背而数落过你？

blocks.en_text: Comments like that might be annoying, but they're not wrong.
blocks.zh_text: 这样的话也许很烦人，但并没有说错。

blocks.en_text: Your posture, the way you hold your body when you're sitting or standing,
blocks.zh_text: 你的姿势，也就是你坐着或站着时身体的样子，

blocks.en_text: is the foundation for every movement your body makes,
blocks.zh_text: 是你身体每一个动作的基础，

blocks.en_text: and can determine how well your body adapts to the stresses on it.
blocks.zh_text: 也决定了你的身体能多好地适应所承受的压力。

blocks.en_text: These stresses can be things like carrying weight,
blocks.zh_text: 这些压力可能是负重之类的事情，

blocks.en_text: or sitting in an awkward position.
blocks.zh_text: 或者是坐在别扭的姿势里。

blocks.en_text: And the big one we all experience all day every day: gravity.
blocks.zh_text: 还有一个我们每天每时每刻都在承受的大压力：重力。

blocks.en_text: If your posture isn't optimal,
blocks.zh_text: 如果你的姿势不够理想，

blocks.en_text: your muscles have to work harder to keep you upright and balanced.
blocks.zh_text: 你的肌肉就得更费力地让你保持直立和平衡。

blocks.en_text: Some muscles will become tight and inflexbile.
blocks.zh_text: 有些肌肉会变得紧绷而僵硬。

blocks.en_text: Others will be inhibited.
blocks.zh_text: 另一些则会受到抑制。

blocks.en_text: Over time, these dysfunctional adaptations
blocks.zh_text: 久而久之，这些失调的适应变化

blocks.en_text: impair your body's ability to deal with the forces on it.
blocks.zh_text: 会损害你身体应对各种外力的能力。

blocks.en_text: Poor posture inflicts extra wear and tear on your joints and ligaments,
blocks.zh_text: 不良姿势会给你的关节和韧带带来额外的磨损，

blocks.en_text: increases the likelihood of accidents,
blocks.zh_text: 增加发生意外的可能性，

blocks.en_text: and makes some organs, like your lungs, less efficient.
blocks.zh_text: 还会让肺等一些器官的效率降低。

blocks.en_text: Researchers have linked poor posture to scoliosis,
blocks.zh_text: 研究人员把不良姿势与脊柱侧弯、

blocks.en_text: tension headaches,
blocks.zh_text: 紧张性头痛

blocks.en_text: and back pain,
blocks.zh_text: 以及背痛联系了起来，

blocks.en_text: though it isn't the exclusive cause of any of them.
blocks.zh_text: 不过它并不是其中任何一种问题的唯一原因。

blocks.en_text: Posture can even influence your emotional state
blocks.zh_text: 姿势甚至会影响你的情绪状态

blocks.en_text: and your sensitivity to pain.
blocks.zh_text: 以及你对疼痛的敏感程度。

blocks.en_text: So there are a lot of reasons to aim for good posture.
blocks.zh_text: 所以，追求良好姿势的理由有很多。

blocks.en_text: But it's getting harder these days.
blocks.zh_text: 但如今这变得越来越难了。

blocks.en_text: Sitting in an awkward position for a long time can promote poor posture,
blocks.zh_text: 长时间保持别扭的姿势会助长不良体态，

blocks.en_text: and so can using computers or mobile devices,
blocks.zh_text: 使用电脑或移动设备也会这样，

blocks.en_text: which encourage you to look downward.
blocks.zh_text: 因为它们会让你低头往下看。

blocks.en_text: Many studies suggest that, on average, posture is getting worse.
blocks.zh_text: 许多研究表明，平均而言，人们的姿势正变得越来越差。

blocks.en_text: So what does good posture look like?
blocks.zh_text: 那么，良好的姿势是什么样子呢？

blocks.en_text: When you look at the spine from the front or the back,
blocks.zh_text: 当你从正面或背面看脊柱时，

blocks.en_text: all 33 vertebrae should appear stacked in a straight line.
blocks.zh_text: 全部33块椎骨应该看起来叠成一条直线。

blocks.en_text: From the side, the spine should have three curves:
blocks.zh_text: 从侧面看，脊柱应该有三个弯曲：

blocks.en_text: one at your neck, one at your shoulders, and one at the small of your back.
blocks.zh_text: 一个在颈部，一个在肩部，一个在腰部。

blocks.en_text: You aren't born with this s-shaped spine.
blocks.zh_text: 你并不是生来就有这种S形脊柱的。

blocks.en_text: Babies' spines just have one curve like a "c."
blocks.zh_text: 婴儿的脊柱只有一个弯曲，像个“C”字。

blocks.en_text: The other curves usually develop by 12-18 months
blocks.zh_text: 其他的弯曲通常在12到18个月大时形成，

blocks.en_text: as the muscles strengthen.
blocks.zh_text: 随着肌肉变得更强壮。

blocks.en_text: These curves help us stay upright and absorb some of the stress
blocks.zh_text: 这些弯曲帮助我们保持直立，并吸收一部分压力，

blocks.en_text: from activities like walking and jumping.
blocks.zh_text: 这些压力来自走路和跳跃之类的活动。

blocks.en_text: If they are aligned properly,
blocks.zh_text: 如果它们排列得当，

blocks.en_text: when you're standing up,
blocks.zh_text: 当你站立时，

blocks.en_text: you should be able to draw a straight line
blocks.zh_text: 你应该能画出一条直线，

blocks.en_text: from a point just in front of your shoulders,
blocks.zh_text: 从你肩膀正前方的一点，

blocks.en_text: to behind your hip,
blocks.zh_text: 一直连到你髋部后方。

blocks.en_text: to the front of your knee,
blocks.zh_text: 到膝盖前方，

blocks.en_text: to a few inches in front of your ankle.
blocks.zh_text: 到脚踝前方几英寸的位置。

blocks.en_text: This keeps your center of gravity directly over your base of support,
blocks.zh_text: 这样能让你的重心正好落在支撑面之上，

blocks.en_text: which allows you to move efficiently
blocks.zh_text: 让你高效地活动，

blocks.en_text: with the least amount of fatigue and muscle strain.
blocks.zh_text: 同时把疲劳和肌肉拉伤降到最低。

blocks.en_text: If you're sitting, your neck should be vertical,
blocks.zh_text: 如果你是坐着，脖子应该保持竖直，

blocks.en_text: not tilted forward.
blocks.zh_text: 不要往前倾。

blocks.en_text: Your shoulders should be relaxed with your arms close to your trunk.
blocks.zh_text: 肩膀要放松，手臂贴近躯干。

blocks.en_text: Your knees should be at a right angle with your feet flat on the floor.
blocks.zh_text: 膝盖应该呈直角，双脚平放在地上。

blocks.en_text: But what if your posture isn't that great?
blocks.zh_text: 但要是你的姿势没那么好呢？

blocks.en_text: Try redesigning your environment.
blocks.zh_text: 试着重新布置一下你的环境。

blocks.en_text: Adjust your screen so it's at or slightly below eyelevel.
blocks.zh_text: 调整屏幕，让它与视线齐平或略低于视线。

blocks.en_text: Make sure all parts of your body,
blocks.zh_text: 确保身体的各个部位，

blocks.en_text: like your elbows and wrists, are supported,
blocks.zh_text: 比如手肘和手腕，都有支撑，

blocks.en_text: using ergonomic aids if you need to.
blocks.zh_text: 需要的话可以用人体工学辅助工具。

blocks.en_text: Try sleeping on your side with your neck supported
blocks.zh_text: 试着侧睡，让脖子有支撑，

blocks.en_text: and with a pillow between your legs.
blocks.zh_text: 并在两腿之间夹个枕头。

blocks.en_text: Wear shoes with low heels and good arch support,
blocks.zh_text: 穿低跟、足弓支撑好的鞋子，

blocks.en_text: and use a headset for phone calls.
blocks.zh_text: 打电话时用耳机。

blocks.en_text: It's also not enough to just have good posture.
blocks.zh_text: 光有好的姿势还不够。

blocks.en_text: Keeping your muscles and joints moving is extremely important.
blocks.zh_text: 让肌肉和关节保持活动极其重要。

blocks.en_text: In fact, being stationary for long periods with good posture
blocks.zh_text: 事实上，长时间保持好姿势不动，

blocks.en_text: can be worse than regular movement with bad posture.
blocks.zh_text: 可能比姿势不好但经常活动还要糟糕。

blocks.en_text: When you do move, move smartly.
blocks.zh_text: 活动的时候，要聪明地活动。

blocks.en_text: Keep anything you're carrying close to your body.
blocks.zh_text: 拿东西时，把它贴近身体。

blocks.en_text: Backpacks should be in contact with your back carried symetrically.
blocks.zh_text: 背包要贴着背部，两边对称地背。

blocks.en_text: If you sit a lot, get up and move around on occassion,
blocks.zh_text: 如果你经常坐着，偶尔起来走动走动，

blocks.en_text: and be sure to exercise.
blocks.zh_text: 并且一定要锻炼。

blocks.en_text: Using your muscles will keep them strong enough to support you effectively,
blocks.zh_text: 用你的肌肉，它们才能保持强壮，有效地支撑你，

blocks.en_text: on top of all the other benefits to your joints, bones, brain and heart.
blocks.zh_text: 此外还能给你的关节、骨骼、大脑和心脏带来种种好处。

blocks.en_text: And if you're really worried, check with a physical therapist,
blocks.zh_text: 如果你真的很担心，就去找物理治疗师看看，

blocks.en_text: because yes, you really should stand up straight.
blocks.zh_text: 因为没错，你真的应该站直了。
